title: PresenceStatus/set missing receiptSharing in updatable fields
description:
Location: draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00.md, PresenceStatus Methods / PresenceStatus/set, line ~1162.

The spec defines PresenceStatus.receiptSharing as a Boolean field with a default of true that the owner can set to false. However, the PresenceStatus/set section lists only 'presence', 'statusText', 'statusEmoji', 'expiresAt' as updatable fields. The 'receiptSharing' field is omitted.

Because RFC 8620 Section 5.3 requires that servers reject updates to fields not listed as updatable (with 'invalidProperties'), an owner cannot change their receiptSharing preference at all. The entire feature is unusable.

Correct behavior: 'receiptSharing' MUST be listed in the PresenceStatus/set update-supported fields.
close_reason: Fixed: receiptSharing added to PresenceStatus/set update list (chat-00.md:1162)
